screenChecks.assessment: Work and author match; 1998 original is distinguished from the linked 1999 paperback. Cover asks the central question without a new thesis.
Selective fiscal vision is presented as administrative power with excluded dimensions, rather than neutral total knowledge.
Non-timber uses and the necessity of abstraction are both retained. This is not an objection to every simplification.
Representation becomes an exercise of power over the actual forest; straight rows, reduced diversity and even ages are directly supported despite missing pp. 16–17.
Real initial timber and commercial gains precede delayed consequences; no invented yield or immediate-failure story.
Soil capital, litter/deadwood and vulnerabilities follow the actual delayed mechanism, expressly attributed to Scott.
Nesting boxes, ant colonies, spiders and mixed restoration results under continued monoculture are actual book examples.
Parcel/owner/tax register is a useful administrative simplification that can change heterogeneous rights; a map is not treated as an innocent mirror.
Legibility remains relative to observer/training. Custom is explicitly unequal; local familiarity does not certify justice.
Ambition to redesign society is differentiated from using science. The high-modernist planner’s certainty is attributed, not prescribed.

All four are a conjunction: administrative ordering, high-modernist faith, coercive authoritarian power and incapacitated civil society. No individual element is made a sufficient or inevitable cause.
Publicity, representation, political competition and informal resistance can modify implementation; no claim that every plan is total or identical.
Le Corbusier’s specified needs and exclusion of plural purposes coexist with real health/sanitation aims.
Costa’s plan and Niemeyer’s buildings are distinguished from Le Corbusier’s doctrinal influence. Humane services and egalitarian aspirations are preserved without calling their achievement automatic.
Holston is attributed through Scott; functional segregation removes informal meeting opportunities. No resident dialogue or scene is invented.
Workers’ settlement/organization and rich enclaves defeat the classless plan; symbiotic margins remain necessary to the formal center. Poverty is not romanticized.
Jacobs’s observed mixed use and nonspecialist street vigilance exemplify experienced functional order, not visual geometry.
The keys/visitor/deli exchange is Jacobs’s actual example in Scott, including sidewalk familiarity rather than intimate friendship.
Soviet private plots/informal resource use and Tanzanian resistance/return track Scott’s own recap. No imported chapter-6/7 chronology, scale, village or unsupported causal detail.
Prescribed buildings, company birds/feed/operations and farmer capital risk are retained as a private-corporate control example in the 1998 text.
Formal instructions depend on unrecognized practices; suppressing them can remove the possibility of repair. No claim that all rules necessarily fail.
Work-to-rule and the specifically less effective Caterpillar engineering procedures are real book examples, not advice to the reader.

Acquired, adaptive, situated skill is differentiated from codified general rules. The word techne is not printed in the digest, but the substantive distinction is preserved; no requirement for extra Greek terminology.
Local harbor knowledge complements general navigation; no invented voyage, mishap or rejection of navigational science.
Actual Malaysian observation: red ants, dry curled nipah leaves as black-ant egg chambers, transfer and saved fruit. No new scene, name or dialogue.
Older neighbors’ experience and social conditions of continued observation/transmission are retained, without claiming a homogeneous timeless culture.
Métis is dynamic. Pesticide use is explicitly Scott’s conditional supposition, not an event; welcome losses of drudgery skills are retained.
Monopolies by guild/class/gender/religious groups and wider access through standardized knowledge keep métis from becoming a romantic equality thesis.
Meiji technical teams investigating farmers’ innovations and laboratory improvement are actual book material, not a modern management analogy.

Citizenship, public health, education and equality before law preserve the qualified defense of state/scientific knowledge; criticism targets universalist pretensions combined with coercive redesign. RU/EN differ naturally in phrasing, without a material causal mismatch.
Closing condenses the retained argument and political/knowledge qualification. It adds no exercise, generic moral, management prescription or blanket anti-government conclusion.
